subject.statement: Trevor Milton is currently serving a prison sentence for fraud.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, Trevor Milton is NOT currently serving a prison sentence for fraud; he was sentenced to four years in December 2023 for securities and wire fraud, but received a full presidential pardon on March 27 2025 and has not served any prison time.

findings.statement: Trevor Milton was sentenced to four years in prison in December 2023 for securities and wire fraud.
Trevor Milton received a full presidential pardon for his fraud conviction on March 27 2025 (sources differ on March 27 vs March 28; the higher‑weight sources support March 27).
As of October 1 2026, Trevor Milton has not served any of his prison sentence and is not incarcerated.

conflict_notes: Pardon date discrepancy: newsweek.com and gov.ca.gov indicate March 27 2025, while eletric-vehicles.com indicates March 28 2025; weighed higher-weight sources (newsweek.com weight 0.65, gov.ca.gov weight 0.95) over lower-weight source (eletric-vehicles.com weight 0.40) and resolved in favor of March 27 2025.
